verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce's documented post-purchase capabilities cover confirming payment outcomes, triggering post-purchase actions, and collecting signals for dispute resolution, but there is no evidence of an API or capability letting an agent query order status or shipment/tracking information after a purchase — that is fulfillment/logistics data outside Visa's payment-rail scope as documented. missing for 10: any order-status/tracking query endpoint, evidence of integration with merchant fulfillment/tracking data, or documentation describing post-purchase order lifecycle visibility for agents.
